data.name: Mohanasundaram
data.gender_notes: Mohanasundaram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mohanasundaram is a combination of three Sanskrit words: 'Mohana' which means 'Moon', 'Sundara' which means 'Victory', and 'Rama' which is a name of God. This name is believed to signify the victory of the divine Rama over the moon, symbolizing the overcoming of distractions and focusing on the divine. The name Mohanasundaram carries the meaning “Moon (Mohana) - Victory (Sundara) - Rama” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mohanasundaram usually hope their child will grow to embody moon (mohana) - victory (sundara) - rama and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of God Rama, signifying the victory of the divine over distractions.
data.etymology: Mohanasundaram belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon (Mohana) - Victory (Sundara) - Rama.”

data.cultural_impact: Mohanasundaram is a Hindu name often found in Tamil Nadu, India. It is a name that carries deep cultural significance, with roots in the Hindu traditions and mythology. The name pays homage to the God Rama, a central figure in Hinduism, and the moon. In Indian culture, the two moons in Hindu mythology are Chandra and Soma. Chandra, also known as Somasundara, is associated with the emotional human soul, while Soma is associated with the rational mind. The name Mohanasundaram reflects the spiritual connection between the human soul and the divine, symbolizing the victory of the divine over distractions, just as the moon (Chandra) is said to have been defeated by Lord Rama.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mohanasundaram has profound spiritual significance for Hindus. At its core, it symbolizes the power of God, particularly the God Rama, in helping individuals overcome distractions and refocus their energies towards the divine. The name serves as a daily reminder of the importance of maintaining spiritual discipline and devotion to the divine. It is also a testament to the belief that victory and success come from within and from a connection to the divine. Ultimately, the name Mohanasundaram represents a deep reverence for the divine and a commitment to spiritual growth and self-improvement.
